instruction: Using ANSYS, maximize the first natural frequency per unit mass for the fixed-fixed beam defined in C:\Users\user\Desktop\problem_spec.json. Open Mechanical APDL from `C:\Program Files\ANSYS Inc\v261\ansys\bin\winx64\ANSYS261.exe`. Start from C:\Users\user\Desktop\baseline_apdl_fixed_beam_modal.db and its result file. Keep the 500 mm beam axis, both fully fixed end interfaces, material, density, BEAM188 formulation, modal analysis type, mesh, and uniform-section restrictions unchanged. Select one uniform RECT or HREC section within the published dimension, wall-thickness, and area limits. Solve the final design and save its native database as C:\Users\user\Desktop\submission.db and its modal result as C:\Users\user\Desktop\submission.rst.
